evidence.V1: Three-quarter and top (ring cut face) read as a stump, but the front view and silhouette read as a hat or bell: the roots merge into a flat brim.
evidence.V2: Big trunk and cut-face rings are present, but the roots are flat flanges and the bark has no grooves, knots or bark lip, so the medium and small tiers are weak.
evidence.V3: Roots are thin flat triangular plates radiating like a shuriken (top view); the trunk is a near-straight faceted cylinder; stiff rather than confidently stylised.
evidence.V4: The base flange has a thin hard step edge, the cut top has a soft rim and the trunk has faceted vertical edges, so edge treatment is inconsistent.
evidence.V5: In close_roots_studio there are smeared shading gradients and a soft crease where the root plates meet the trunk, plus visible faceting on the trunk sides.
evidence.V6: Bark brown in two values with cream and tan rings; disciplined. Rings almost disappear in the birch colourway.
evidence.V8: Single vertex-colour material and a fused shell fit the kit, but the flat-plate roots and faceted trunk do not match the kit's soft organic shells.
evidence.V9: Studio line correct: Anchored, Hull collision, CanTouch off, white MeshPart, bottom-centre origin.

artifacts: Shading smear and soft crease at root-to-trunk junctions (close_roots_studio)
top_fixes: Rebuild the roots as rounded tapering lobes that rise up the trunk and dive into the ground, not flat plates
Add a bark lip or rim around the cut face and a few vertical bark grooves or a knot for small detail
Increase segment count on the trunk and roots slightly and fix the normals at the junctions to remove smears and faceting
